segments.name: Packaging
segments.description: Produces containerboard and corrugated packaging products for industrial and consumer goods manufacturers.
segments.evidence: Our Packaging segment produces a wide variety of containerboard and corrugated packaging products.

segments.name: Paper
segments.description: Manufactures and sells communication-based papers, including commodity and specialty uncoated freesheet papers.
segments.evidence: The Paper segment manufactures and sells a range of communication-based papers.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay PCA for containerboard, corrugated packaging, and paper products, with revenue recognized when products are shipped from the mill or manufacturing facility.
revenueModel.evidence: For most packaging and paper products, revenue is recognized when the product is shipped from the mill or from our manufacturing facility to our customer.

changes.text: In 2025, PCA acquired the containerboard business of Greif, Inc., with results included in the Packaging segment.
changes.evidence: On September 2, 2025, we completed the acquisition of the containerboard business of Greif, Inc. for $1.8 billion in cash.
